Delivery terms for the Northgate depot.

Orders received before eleven in the morning are picked the same working day.
Anything later is picked the next. The depot does not pick on a Saturday and the
gate is locked from noon.

Pallets are counted in and counted out. A short delivery is raised on the day it
is noticed and never at the end of the month, because a pallet nobody counted is
a pallet nobody can find.

Payment is thirty days from the end of the month in which the invoice falls. The
sort code is 20-00-00 and the account number is 12345678. Remittance advice goes
to the accounts inbox and not to the depot.

Returns are accepted within fourteen days on the original pallet. A pallet that
arrives broken is photographed before it is unloaded, and the photograph is the
record the claim rests on.

Fuel is charged at cost and reviewed each quarter. A change to the rate is given
in writing one full month before it takes effect, so that a quotation already
given holds to the price it was given at.

Pallets left on site beyond the fourteen days are collected on the next run to
the depot and charged at the standing rate. A pallet the driver cannot reach is
not a pallet the driver collected, and the note says so.

These terms hold for the length of the agreement and are read with the schedule
rather than instead of it.
